_description: Retrieval ground truth for the Lebanese Penal Code corpus. relevant_articles = the Penal Code article numbers that correctly answer the query (language-agnostic: an article is relevant whether retrieved in Arabic or English). Used by scripts/eval_retrieval.py to compute precision@k, recall@k, MRR, nDCG.
